_comment: Hoeffding's D explainer lexicon (2026-10-12 redo, the name read HERF-ding at the owner's request). Only respell and accept change narration; say/ipa/lang/sources/decoy/note/probe are the pronunciation record. Voice robert, ftts 0.1.11, FrankenWhisper (fw 0.10.0); the name probed with probe_names.py (control + decoy, three carriers, then five possessive carriers from the script). Re-probe when the voice or the ftts version changes.

Hoeffding.note: The owner's pronunciation (2026-10-12), which overrides every source: closer to HERF-ding, the rounded vowel of German ö. lookup_pronunciation.py (context 'statistician Wassily Hoeffding') finds no IPA in any source (the two Wikipedia pages listed); its rule-based reading of the German spelling is /ˈhœfdɪŋ/, and English has no /œ/, whose nearest vowel is the one in 'her'. Voice robert, ftts 0.1.11. The v5 narration said HEFF-ding, kept here as the decoy. Not read: the plain spelling (robert says HOFF-ding; heard 'hofting', 'Hoefding'), Herfding (weak f; heard 'curveding', 'Hervding', 'Herbding') and HERF-ding in capitals (split in two script sentences: 'Hurf, Dings, D', 'Herf Dings'). accept holds only the two ASR spellings of the HERF read, so a HEFF or HOFF read ('hefting', 'hofting') counts as a misheard name.

carriers: The idea came from {w}, in the end.
One of the most elegant is called {w}'s D.
And this is {w}'s D, recomputed live from the dots on every single frame.
{w}'s trick is to never list them at all.

probe.script: every take of the 9 script sentences with the name: Herf-ding 9/9 heard Herfding/Herfting, Hurfding 8/9 (h7 once 'Herfning'); HERF-ding 7/9, dropped

acoustic.method: LPC formants (order 12 at 11.025 kHz, 25 ms frames) of the name's first vowel, median over the middle of the voiced run, read beside a wideband spectrogram; evidence for the eye, not proof
acoustic.measure: an r-coloured vowel (HERF) has F3 pulled down next to F2; the vowel of HEFF keeps F3 near 2.4 kHz with F2 near 1.75 kHz; HOFF has F2 under 1 kHz
acoustic.references: in "{w}'s D asks a deeper question.": plain Hoeffding F2 832 / F3 2275 Hz; HEFF-ding F2 1741 / F3 2428; Herf-ding F2 1160 / F3 1503; Hurfding F2 1323 / F3 1472
acoustic.script: the take chosen for each of the 9 name sentences on 2026-10-12 03:13 (5 Hurfding, 4 Herf-ding): F2 1131-1318 Hz, F3 1314-1586 Hz, all r-coloured. Where the name starts a sentence the /h/ is kept.

manim.note: Coined name (math animation library): the project's own usage. 'Mannheim' is a wrong read.

tau.note: Kendall's tau. English /taʊ/ (Wikipedia: Tau). Voice robert, 2026-10-12: sentence-final in h3 the plain read was once written 'tile' by the ASR, so a second spelling is auditioned and a misheard tau now counts as a misheard name.

scatter.note: Ordinary word, here because robert's read of r2 'as a scatter plot' was written 'statter plot' by the ASR at take and line level (2026-10-12): the k is weak. A second spelling is auditioned, and a 'statter' read now counts as a miss.
